what: genetic values and what reads them for founders on map (a), the template of map 4, and map (b), the same with mean_ref 0.25 on core:longevity and -0.5 on core:growth (hash.json)
data: the template documents (tests/golden/map4_template with data/calibration/demography.json), the full template: disease loci, MC1R, HERC2, all diseases; map (b) as hash.json case b_two_means
founders: founder i is the i-th founder of a Start with world seed 0x9f1 and founder tag test:gf: lineage key LineageKey::founder("test:gf", i), no parents (C at its own key for both parents), born the given second (age 30 at the start); every locus not listed holds allele 0; alleles [maternal, paternal]
rule: G = (A - mean_ref) / sigma_ref in f64, one subtraction then one division, when the map has a mean_ref; G = A / sigma_ref (no subtraction) without. Here A is an integer (d_ref 1, effect 1, load 1) and A - mean_ref is exact, so G_b is the correctly rounded (A - m) / sigma: bit for bit. G_b against G_a - m / sigma: within 1 ulp (equal for most); the cases listed in 'order_matters' differ, so they tell the operation order apart
order_matters: alternative core:growth: (A - m) / sigma and A / sigma - m / sigma differ by 1 ulp
prerun_small_0 core:growth: (A - m) / sigma and A / sigma - m / sigma differ by 1 ulp
controls: core:face_01 includes core:growth (weight 0.15) but has no mean_ref of its own: its G is the same in both maps; core:cognition and core:puberty have no mean_ref: their G and z are the same in both maps
phenotype: world_reference.phenotype_parts: z = ((sqrt(h2) * G) + (sqrt(c2) * C)) + (sqrt(e2) * E) with E = normal(ENV_INDIVIDUAL, key, str_key(trait), 0) and C = normal(ENV_SHARED, key, str_key(trait), key) at the world seed; ages 0 and 30 years (30 * 31449600 s)
longevity: g_L = G of core:longevity, g_hat = g_L held on [-6, 6], m = exp(-(sigma_g * g_hat)) (correctly rounded, sigma_g 0.724), delta = ((-sigma_g) * g_hat) / b_sex, bio_age_75 = 25 + (75 - 25) * exp((0.5 * delta) / 50)
f64: every *_bits is the f64 as 16 hex digits, big endian (sign first)

genomes.how: allele 1 on both copies of every additive locus (dose 2)

genomes.name: heterozygous
